title: How To Interpreter
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: HOW TO INTERPRETER SAVE01
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 17125; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
5 CLEAR 5000:CLS
10 IN=0:RN=0:CN=0:LN=0:MN=0:VN=0
15 TC$="PLEASE CONTINUE EXPLAINING "
20 DIM P$(70),MT$(20),VT$(40)
100 PRINT"WHAT ARE YOU GOING TO TELL ME HOW TO DO?":PRINT"HOW TO ";:GOSUB 950:T=0:MT$(0)="NULL1"+T$:PRINT:T1=1:T$(0)=T$:GOTO 220
150 PRINT CHR$(94);:GOSUB 950
160 IF T$="THAT'S ALL"OR T$="THATS ALL" OR T$="THAT IS ALL"THEN 200 ELSE IF LEFT$(T$,4)="MAKE"THEN 300 ELSE IF LEFT$(T$,7)="COMPUTE" THEN 400 ELSE IF LEFT$(T$,3)="NOW"THEN500 ELSE IF LEFT$(T$,5)="FIRST"THEN 600 ELSE IF LEFT$(T$,5)="WHILE" THEN 700
170 IF LEFT$(T$,4)="LIST"THEN 800
180 PRINT:PRINT"I DON'T UNDERSTAND, PLEASE SAY 'THAT'S ALL' OR 'LIST', OR WRITE A STATMENT WITH 'MAKE','NOW','COMPUTE','FIRST - WHILE - THEN',  OR 'IF - THEN - ELSE'":PRINT:GOTO 150
200 PRINT:PRINT"OK":PRINT
210 FOR T=MN TO 0 STEP -1:IF LEFT$(MT$(T),4)<>"NULL"THEN NEXT T:GOTO 1100 ELSE T1=VAL( MID$(MT$(T),5,1)):T$(0)=MID$(MT$(T),6)
220 T$(1)="HOW TO ":T$(2)=T$(1)+"FIND ":T$(3)=T$(2)+" WHEN "
